tei:div.tei:p: The peace-offerings are [also] of lesser sanctity. They are slaughtered anywhere in the Courtyard, and their blood requires two applications which are [like] four. They may be eaten anywhere in the city by anyone, and prepared for eating in any fashion, for two days and one night. The portion given to the Kohanim has the same rule, but may be eaten only by the Kohanim, their wives, children, and slaves.

tei:note.tei:p: That day, the following night and the following day.
